summary: Extending a segui entry or changing its label must keep snapshots novita has not reported yet.
reason: Re-saving every watched article replaces the hash novita diffs against. A change that landed before the next article was added would then look unchanged.
validated_outcome: TestSeguiExtendKeepsExistingSnapshots: adding article 6 and renaming the entry leave article 5's stored hash in place and still baseline the new article.
